mapper.select: SELECT v.version_id,v.entity_kind,v.content_sha256, CASE v.entity_kind WHEN 'SOURCE_VERSION' THEN s.classification WHEN 'ARTIFACT' THEN a.classification WHEN 'RULE_VERSION' THEN r.classification END AS classification, CASE v.entity_kind WHEN 'SOURCE_VERSION' THEN s.classification WHEN 'ARTIFACT' THEN a.classification WHEN 'RULE_VERSION' THEN r.classification END AS owner_classification FROM version_registry v LEFT JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=v.version_id AND sv.original_sha256=v.content_sha256 LEFT JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id LEFT JOIN artifact a ON a.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND a.artifact_id=v.version_id AND a.content_sha256=v.content_sha256 LEFT JOIN rule_version r ON r.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND r.rule_version=v.version_id AND r.content_sha256=v.content_sha256 WHERE v.version_id=#{versionId} AND v.entity_kind IN ('SOURCE_VERSION','ARTIFACT','RULE_VERSION')
SELECT tenant_id,record_id,content_sha256,snapshot_json,snapshot_sha256,input_schema_sha256,policy_schema_sha256 FROM formal_evaluation_policy_input WHERE record_id=#{recordId} FOR SHARE
